name: Hallucination's clones despawn after their tooltip duration, not 15 seconds (#4360)
contract: Hallucination 560301 tooltip: 'Create 3 copies of yourself that run in a random direction for $706932d and may briefly trick enemies into ignoring you.' $706932d resolves to spell 706932's own DurationIndex, SpellDuration.dbc id 27 = 3000 ms (confirmed via coa-dbc-viewer record --id 706932 / --table SpellDuration --id 27). spell_ascension_cultist_ability::Effect (AscensionCultistAbilities.cpp) hardcoded the three Summon(player, 840000, ...) calls that back the clones to a literal 15000 ms instead of reading 706932's own duration, so the clones outlived the tooltip's 3 seconds fivefold. AscensionCultistSummons.cpp's Summon() remaps entry 840000 to HallucinationEntry (840025, the real creature_template row) before spawning, so this scenario counts entry 840025, the entry the clones actually spawn with.

steps.label: DISCRIMINATING: the clones are gone by 3.5s, not still alive from a 15s duration (#4360)
